title: Mirabel and the Language
author: Jonah Dravenmoor
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
